cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.layout import WindowLayout, pack_flags, iter_set_bits, set_bit_range

rng=random.Random(5)
bad=0
for trial in range(300):
    F=rng.randint(1,3); K=rng.randint(1,3)
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':'count','domain':sorted(rng.sample(range(50),rng.randint(1,4)))} for i in range(F)]
    L=WindowLayout(fields,K)
    if L.size>5000: continue
    windows=[L.decode(i) for i in range(L.size)]
    # check encode/decode round trip
    for i,w in enumerate(windows):
        if L.encode(w)!=i: bad+=1; print('encode fail'); break
    # check cell_equal_mask
    for c in range(L.cell_count):
        for p in range(L.cell_sizes[c]):
            mask=L.cell_equal_mask(c,p)
            want=pack_flags((w[c]==L.domain_of_cell(c)[p] for w in windows), L.size)
            if mask!=want: bad+=1; print('eq mask fail',c,p); break
    # check value_mask with random truth
    c=rng.randrange(L.cell_count)
    truth=[rng.random()<0.5 for _ in range(L.cell_sizes[c])]
    mask=L.value_mask(c,truth)
    want=pack_flags((truth[[L.domain_of_cell(c).index(w[c])][0]] for w in windows), L.size)
    if mask!=want: bad+=1; print('value mask fail')
    # iter_set_bits
    if list(iter_set_bits(mask,(L.size+7)//8))!=sorted(i for i in range(L.size) if (mask>>i)&1):
        bad+=1; print('iter fail')
    if bad: break
# set_bit_range edge cases
for start in range(0,40):
    for count in range(1,20):
        ba=bytearray(16)
        set_bit_range(ba,start,count)
        want=0
        for b in range(start,start+count): want |= 1<<b
        got=int.from_bytes(ba,'little')
        if got!=want: bad+=1; print('set_bit_range fail',start,count,bin(got),bin(want)); break
print('layout trials failures:',bad)
PYEOF
